lines.vo: Bad week? Being kind to yourself may get you back faster.
That's not going soft. That's how you get back up.
So Tasha writes one kind line and one next step in her Life Reset Planner.
At UC Berkeley, students took a really hard vocabulary test, and most did badly.
Some were then asked to treat the failure with self compassion. Others got a self esteem boost.
Before a second test, the self compassion group chose to study longer than the others.
Kindness seemed to make the mistake feel safe enough to face, instead of something to avoid.
Be kind, then take the next step. That's how you stay on track.
